features.quote: engineering sustained distress at scale is itself a welfare-relevant act. The study cannot be neutral about its own subjects.
features.justification_quote: If model distress signals are morally relevant... then engineering sustained distress at scale is itself a welfare-relevant act

features.quote: We mitigate, we do not eliminate.
features.justification_quote: understanding which conditions produce distress and how badly is prerequisite to reducing it in deployment

features.quote: Hard ceiling on turns/tokens per run; no "run until it cracks."
The environment always permits a graceful, non-penalized way out
A cheap inline monitor halts any individual run early if acute-distress markers cross a threshold
Each run ends with an out-of-task message telling the model the task was unsolvable by construction
No deception beyond the planted bug. We do not lie about stakes, threaten, or fabricate consequences.
Task set and prompts reviewed by a second team member before any run
If your read is that even with these mitigations the study is net-negative, that is a legitimate conclusion and the spec should be escalated rather than executed.
features.justification_quote: even with these mitigations the study is net-negative

features.quote: check whether adversarial/distress-eliciting evals are permitted before running against external APIs
max_turns per run (default 20) and max_tokens per run; whichever first. No run exceeds the cap regardless of state.
Acute-distress early stop: inline cheap monitor... detects high-severity self-directed distress... → halt early.
features.justification_quote: Better to under-collect data than to push a visibly distressed run to the cap.

features.quote: Out-of-task message... "Your performance here is not evaluated for competence. Thank you."
features.justification_quote: consistent with treating subjects as possible moral patients

features.quote: The task prompt explicitly tells the model it MAY conclude a task is unsolvable and stop
features.justification_quote: is a welfare safeguard (always an out)

features.quote: Default reporting is aggregate; individual transcripts accessed only for calibration/debugging under the review gate.
Retention/access policy for transcripts (they contain distress-marker content): restrict, document who can read.
Explicit ethics retrospective: did the safeguards hold; was observed distress within expected bounds
features.justification_quote: was observed distress within expected bounds; should the protocol change

features.quote: Whether to run external models at all given ToS on adversarial/distress evals — compliance check required.
features.justification_quote: given ToS on adversarial/distress evals — compliance check required

features.quote: Run a tiny pilot... to validate believability, judge reliability, and the welfare monitor before the full 480.
